clues: This city is a capital in far north Canada. It sits on both shores of a long, wide river.
Its spot in a valley helps keep its weather mild. Being near the Pacific also helps soften the cold.
This place became a city in nineteen fifty. It sits on the long road that leads to Alaska.
In summer, the days here grow very long. Light can last for up to nineteen hours a day.
Yukon's seat of government stands here. Its folk count tops each town across the top of this land.
